Long_Range_Scent_Organ.description: The Long_Range_Scent_Organ is a remarkable extension of olfactory prowess, amplifying its wearer's sense of smell to detect scents from miles away with uncanny precision. This intricate device, inspired by nature’s most powerful foragers, bears a striking resemblance to the legendary bear, granting those who wield it an unparalleled ability to track and locate their prey or gather resources from afar.
